 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare kind text;
begin
  select project_kind into kind from public.projects where id = new.project_id;
  if kind = 'kommersiell' and new.engagement_type = 'volunteer' then
    raise exception 'Volontärroller är inte tillåtna i kommersiella projekt';
  end if;
  if kind is distinct from 'kommersiell' and new.engagement_type = 'paid' then
    raise exception 'Betalda roller är endast tillåtna i kommersiella projekt';
  end if;
  return new;
end $function$
"},{"name":"handle_new_user","schema":"public","definition":"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.handle_new_user()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare v_role text;
begin
  v_role := coalesce(new.raw_user_meta_data->>'role', 'volunteer');
  if new.email in ('evgeniya.leonidovna@gmail.com','oumma.ee@gmail.com') then
    v_role := 'admin';
  end if;
  insert into public.users (id, email, full_name, role, municipality, username)
  values (
    new.id,
    new.email,
    coalesce(new.raw_user_meta_data->>'full_name', ''),
    v_role,
    new.raw_user_meta_data->>'municipality',
    lower(regexp_replace(split_part(coalesce(new.email,''), '@', 1), '[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]', '', 'g'))
      || '_' || substr(new.id::text, 1, 4)
  )
  on conflict (id) do nothing;
  return new;
end $function$

"},{"name":"is_project_manager","schema":"public","definition":"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_project_manager(p_project uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  select exists (
    select 1 from public.projects pr
    where pr.id = p_project and (
      pr.creator_id = auth.uid()
      or pr.mentor_id = auth.uid()
      or exists (select 1 from public.organization_members om
                 where om.organization_id = pr.organization_id
                   and om.user_id = auth.uid()
                   and om.org_role in ('owner','manager'))
      or exists (select 1 from public.users u
                 where u.id = auth.uid() and u.role = 'admin')
    )
  );
$function$
